STALE: GASTAT's last published Marriage and Divorce bulletin covers 2020 (MoJ admin records: marriage contracts, divorce deeds). No verified 2021-2025 annual totals found; widely cited '12.6%' and '168/day' figures unsourced.

No national annual totals found. Fragments only: 473 divorces in 2024 in federal courts of Sharjah/Ajman/Fujairah/UAQ; Abu Dhabi civil-family-court civil marriages 16,200 (2024). Dubai DSC Emirati-only rate reports exist but were access-blocked.
No annual total retrieved. NPC monthly bulletins 2024 e.g. Jul: 348 marriage contracts / 244 divorce certificates; data.gov.qa marriage series ends 2022, no divorce series.
Ministry of Justice statistical yearbook; all nationalities (Kuwaiti couples 72.2% of marriages). 2023: 13,303 / 7,865.
Bahrain Open Data Portal (iGA). 2024: 5,057 / 2,073, crude 3.2 / 1.3. GDN's '4.3pc' is the general marriage rate (dataset 2b), not crude.
NCSI registered marriage contracts / divorce documents, via news report. 2024: 17,896 / 4,122; 2023: 14,716 / 3,828.

Supreme Judge Dept (Sharia courts) annual report 2024; marriages +5.3% vs 2023 but absolute count not found. Divorces include pre-consummation, judicial separation (5,822) and iftida/khula-type (359). 2023: 25,887 divorces.

Information International from Directorate General of Personal Status (all sects' religious courts). Article dated 12 Sep 2024 labels figures '2024' - likely 2023 full year or partial; treat year as uncertain.

CBS 'Israel in Figures 2025' (couples who married / divorced, 2023); registered with Population Authority, excludes civil marriages abroad not registered. 2024 CBS not yet out; Rabbinical Courts report 11,542 Jewish divorces in 2024 (10,838 in 2023).
CAPMAS Annual Bulletin of Marriage & Divorce 2024; divorces = 259,697 ma'dhun divorce certificates + 14,195 final court rulings (incl. khula). 2023: 961,220 / 265,606.
ONS Demographie algerienne; divorces from Ministry of Justice (all types incl. khula). 2024: ~282,000 marriages reported, divorces 2024 not found.

Divorces = CSPJ talaq cases 2024 (96.8% mutual consent); EXCLUDES 107,681 tatliq (judicial dissolution) cases - with tatliq total dissolutions 147,895. Marriage count from Justice Minister statement Nov 2024 (may be partial year). HCP cites >65,000 divorces 2024. Ratio not like-for-like.
INS: marriage contracts and divorce judgments of first-instance courts. Viral '35,000 divorces' claim is not INS data.
No national registry totals found; only municipal fragments (e.g. Tajoura 2024: 1,460 marriages / 327 divorces).

Stats SA P0307 (released 19 Mar 2026). Marriages = 97,510 civil + 2,634 customary + 2,229 civil unions registered at DHA; divorces = completed forms processed (undercount, late reports). Divorce rate given as 39 per 100,000.

Source rates are PERSONS per 1,000 (13.7 married, 4.3 divorced); halved here to events per 1,000; ratio from rates. Divorce counts not found.
